recipe.visualDefinition: A highly symmetrical, four-pointed crystalline emblem resembling a complex snowflake, centered on a pitch-black background. The emblem features internal geometric patterns and glows with a cold blue light, positioned above heavy, chiseled, ice-textured display typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical alignment between the central emblem and the primary title
High contrast between the luminous blue elements and the absolute black negative space
Texture consistency between the crystalline emblem and the stone-like typography
Radial symmetry of the emblem mirroring the horizontal weight of the text
coreInvariants: Icy blue color palette with internal white highlights
Chiseled, rough-hewn texture on the main lettering

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The crystalline emblem occupies the upper two-thirds of the frame; the title occupies the lower third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central diamond-shaped core of the snowflake emblem.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the glowing center of the emblem, radiates outward along the crystal spikes, then drops down to the heavy textured title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive black space surrounds the elements, emphasizing the glow and isolation.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black background for maximum contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Electric blue and cyan for the glow and highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cool grey and white for the chiseled stone textures.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast; saturation is concentrated in the glowing edges while the interiors are desaturated and icy.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, wide-set serif with flared terminals.
letterConstructionRules: Letters must appear carved from ancient ice or stone
Rough, irregular edges suggesting natural erosion
Top edges catch a bright blue rim light
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'O' features a swirling, organic internal curve
Roman numerals are rendered as thick, chiseled pillars

composition.relationshipToImage: anchors the composition below the graphic

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A smaller, elegant script or sans-serif sits directly above the main title for secondary branding.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the classical, cinematic foundation for the serif structure.
The texture is too specific for a standard font; requires 3D rendering or heavy digital painting.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a symmetrical, four-pointed ice crystal emblem with intricate internal geometric patterns and glowing blue edges on a solid black background. Ensure the crystal has needle-like spikes radiating from a central diamond core.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply heavy, chiseled stone-textured uppercase serif lettering centered at the bottom. The letters should have a weathered, icy appearance with a subtle blue glow on the top edges.

verificationChecks: Does the emblem have four primary points?
Is the text texture consistent with chiseled ice?
Is the blue glow concentrated on the edges and highlights?

adjustableVariables: Complexity of the internal crystal patterns
Degree of weathering on the typography
Vertical spacing between emblem and text
mustRedesign: Unique character-based symbols inside the crystal
postGenerationChecks: Check for symmetry in the crystal spikes
Ensure the text feels heavy and grounded
Verify the glow does not wash out the black background
Confirm the texture looks like stone/ice rather than metal
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central, glowing radial geometric emblem with heavy, textured, chiseled display type on a dark field to create a cold, epic fantasy aesthetic.
